items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: the second trumpet player, Ray Ludwig was the guy who was beating off the tempos... Ludwig had charge of the library and that part of the band.

ctx.x: Well, Trumbauer started telling me about a deal he had to join that band and Horvath said that when he got to New York he could stand up in front of the band. However, the second trumpet player, Ray Ludwig was the guy who was beating off the tempos.
